title: Why winner of biggest prize in maths has decided to work on AI instead | New Scientist
description: Jacob Tsimerman won a Fields medal last month – now he is leaving mathematics to work on AI safety
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: OpenAI announces solutions to 10 longstanding maths problems | New Scientist
description: Ten conundrums that stumped human mathematicians for years have been cracked by OpenAI's Astra model, continuing a hot streak of AI-driven breakthroughs that are shaking up the field
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Why sitting under a parasol is barely cooler than being in the sun | New Scientist
description: A beach umbrella might protect you from sunburn, but when it comes to keeping you cool, it makes surprisingly little difference
author: Michael Le Page

title: How Europe can make its landscapes more fire-resilient | New Scientist
description: Paradoxically, suppressing wildfires has also made European countries more vulnerable to huge blazes like those seen in France and Spain this week. With global warming also amplifying the danger, some experts are calling for a change of strategy
author: Alec Luhn

title: Climate change may help eliminate malaria from West and Central Africa | New Scientist
description: Global warming may make it too hot for malaria-carrying mosquitoes to survive in parts of Africa, but could also shift the problem to less affected areas
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Could eating less protein slow ageing? | New Scientist
description: Protein is everywhere, but studies – mostly in non-human animals – suggest that limiting our intake could extend our lifespan
author: Carissa Wong
